summary: Container enterprise NGINX ports: controller 8080/8443 (controller_nginx_http_port/https_port), hub 8081/8444 (hub_nginx_*), EDA 8082/8445 (eda_nginx_*), gateway 8083/8446 (gateway_nginx_*); Receptor mesh nodes connect through hop nodes. Check default ports for conflicts when changing them.
questions: What are the default NGINX ports for each containerized AAP component?
How do I change the automation hub NGINX port in a containerized install?
Which inventory variable sets the gateway NGINX HTTPS port?

answer_card.title: Containerized AAP NGINX ports
answer_card.answer_md:
| Component | HTTP/HTTPS | Inventory variables |
|---|---|---|
| Controller | 8080/8443 | `controller_nginx_http_port`, `controller_nginx_https_port` |
| Hub | 8081/8444 | `hub_nginx_http_port`, `hub_nginx_https_port` |
| EDA | 8082/8445 | `eda_nginx_http_port`, `eda_nginx_https_port` |
| Gateway | 8083/8446 | `gateway_nginx_http_port`, `gateway_nginx_https_port` |
